items: 【2026 Latest Tablet】 Dive into the future of mobile tech with our latest tablet. Powered by GMS - certified Android 15, this tablet is a memory - management maestro. Effortlessly switch between emails, documents, and Vedio on the tablet, as apps open in a blink. The 2026 FEARWIKY Tablet, loaded with cutting - edge features, guarantees a buttery - smooth experience for work tasks and gaming sessions alike. Despite packing top - tier technology, this tablet offers an unbeatable price, making it the ultimate choice for anyone craving high - end quality without breaking the bank.

【20GB+128GB High Performance Android Tablet】 This 10.4-inch, touchscreen Android Tablet is equipped with an 8-core CPU and A523 chip, enabling smooth multitasking. With 20GB of RAM and 128 GB of ROM, it can be expanded up to 1 TB via a TF card (not included), enabling smooth multitasking and app switching. This tablet also comes with the Google Play Store pre-installed, so you can download the apps you need with ease.

【10.4-inch IPS HD Touchscreen】 The FEARWIKY Android Tablet features a high-resolution 10.4-inch IPS screen with a resolution of 1280 x 800 pixels. IPS technology ensures consistent colour and brightness from any angle, providing crisp, sharp images. It provides smooth visuals and vibrant colours for an amazing viewing experience. Enjoy clear picture quality from any angle, capture every detail and say goodbye to colour distortion as you immerse yourself in a captivating visual experience.

【Dual-core Speed, Wireless Innovation】 This Android 15 tablet combines the latest sixth-generation Wi-Fi technology with upgraded Bluetooth 5.3 to redefine the wireless experience! Bluetooth 5.3 offers lower power consumption, stronger interference resistance and stable, smooth connections with multiple devices. Wi-Fi 6 delivers lightning-fast speeds, smooth performance with multiple connected devices and seamless 4K HD streaming and online gaming. Whether you're enjoying multimedia entertainment, working remotely, or competing in esports, this tablet stays ahead of the curve and remains rock-solid!

【Lightweight and Portable】This 10.4-inch tablet has a slim design, with a body thickness of just 1.0 cm. Enjoy e-books, movies, TV shows and music effortlessly while travelling or on the go. The FEARWIKY tablet also comes with a one-year warranty. The FEARWIKY team is dedicated to offering dependable products and exceptional customer service, ensuring a positive shopping experience. If you have any questions about this tablet, please contact us promptly.
